title: Single-Instance Lock (flock) Wrapper
description: Runs a command under an flock-guarded shell task on each target host, so two overlapping playbook runs never execute the guarded command on the same machine at the same time.

variables.name: COMMAND_DESCRIPTION
variables.prompt: One-line description of the work being guarded (used as the task name)

variables.name: COMMAND_TO_RUN
variables.prompt: The exact command to run while holding the lock

toggle_groups.name: LOCK_MODE
toggle_groups.prompt: If another instance is already running on that host

options.label: wait for it to finish, then run anyway
